verdict.rationale: HubSpot's CRM API supports creating/managing contacts and custom objects individually or in batches, syncing data between systems, and its webhooks journal API provides real-time event subscription (a change-detection mechanism); API versioning and deprecation policies are also documented. However, no evidence explicitly documents rate limits (numeric caps, throttling) or upsert-specific endpoints/semantics, which are core parts of the story.  Missing for 10: explicit rate-limit documentation, explicit upsert endpoint/behavior documentation, independent/hands-on validation of sync at scale.
